# MatDrive

> MatDrive is a self-hosted drive in the browser, like the cloud drives people know: every person has My Drive, teams have shared drives, files and folders are shared with people (viewer, editor) or through links (password, end date, upload into a folder), files keep versions, deleted items lie in a trash, and the drive can be mounted through WebDAV. It also browses the storage locations of a NAS (local folders, SMB, SFTP, FTP, WebDAV) like a file explorer, and opens office files in MatOffice. It is a Progressive Web App.

Everything except the start page needs an account or a shared link. The interface is available in English and German.

## What a person can do

- Upload files and whole folders (drag & drop, large files in pieces), download files and folders (zip), preview pictures, videos, audio, PDFs and text.
- Create folders, rename, move, copy, star, delete into the trash and restore; unpack zip files; edit text files in the browser.
- Keep every version of a file, restore or download an older one, keep versions forever.
- Share files and folders with people, give out links (with a password, an end date, with or without download, upload into a folder).
- Work in shared drives with members (viewer, editor, manager).
- Search names and the text of text files; see recent and starred items; see the activity of an item.
- Open Word, Excel, PowerPoint and MatOffice files in MatOffice (when it is connected) and save them back as new versions.
- Mount the drive with WebDAV (address /dav/, user = e-mail address, password = an app password).
- Sign in locally or through MatIdentity; mails go through MatSMTP (both optional, set up by Mattiverse).
